rules.title: Build a five-incident log
rules.summary: San Jose Animal Care requires a case number and a signed nuisance log with at least five documented incidents.
rules.captureInstruction: Record the start time, end time, duration, and how the barking interfered with the reasonable use of your home.
rules.nextAction: Contact Animal Care first for a case number. After five incidents, submit the signed petition and original log.

rules.title: Report it while it is happening
rules.summary: San Jose directs active noise disturbances to the Police Department's non-emergency line.
rules.captureInstruction: Measure from the place where the disturbance affects you. Keep a separate record of each date, time, and duration.
rules.nextAction: For an active ordinary noise disturbance, call the police non-emergency line. Use emergency services only for an immediate threat.
rules.officialSourceLabel: City of San Jose contact directory

rules.title: Check the permit and the clock
rules.summary: For construction covered by a development permit or planning approval within 500 feet of a residence, San Jose generally allows work only from 7:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m., Monday through Friday, and prohibits it on weekends. An approved permit or planning approval may expressly allow different hours.
rules.captureInstruction: Document the work address, activity, start and end times, approximate distance from the nearest home, and any posted permit or after-hours notice.
rules.nextAction: Check for a posted permit or approved exception. If the work appears outside its allowed hours, submit a Code Enforcement service request with the address and your incident history.

rules.title: Follow city procedures
rules.summary: Barking or howling dogs causing a nuisance can be reported to Animal Services. If the problem persists, an additional complaint can be filed after 30 days, or the issue can be handled in civil court.
rules.captureInstruction: Document the date, time, and nature of the noise.
rules.nextAction: Contact Animal Services to report the issue.

rules.title: Follow city procedures
rules.summary: Playing or operating any radio, stereo, or musical device in a loud or disturbing manner is prohibited. Operating loudspeakers to project sound outside a building or vehicle requires a permit from the Chief of Police.
rules.captureInstruction: Document the date, time, and nature of the noise.
rules.nextAction: Contact Police Department to report the issue.

rules.title: Follow city procedures
rules.summary: Construction activity and heavy equipment operation are prohibited on weekdays from 6:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. (or 5:00 p.m. to 8:00 a.m. if within 300 feet of occupied dwellings). On weekends and holidays, they are prohibited from 5:00 p.m. to 9:00 a.m.
rules.captureInstruction: Document the date, time, and nature of the noise.
rules.nextAction: Contact Code Enforcement to report the issue.

rules.title: Follow city procedures
rules.summary: Owning or harboring any animal which barks or makes annoying noises continuously or incessantly for an unreasonable period of time so as to create a noise disturbance across a real property line is a nuisance.
rules.captureInstruction: Document the date, time, and nature of the noise.
rules.nextAction: Contact Oakland Animal Services to report the issue.

rules.title: Follow city procedures
rules.summary: Using any mechanical or electronic device for the intensification of any sound or noise, including loud music, into the public streets which produces excessive or annoying noise is a nuisance.
rules.captureInstruction: Document the date, time, and nature of the noise.
rules.nextAction: Contact Oakland Police Department to report the issue.

rules.title: Follow city procedures
rules.summary: Nighttime construction noise between 7:00 p.m. and 7:00 a.m. on weekdays, or between 8:00 p.m. and 9:00 a.m. on weekends and holidays, shall not exceed applicable nighttime noise standards. Pile drivers and jack hammers are prohibited on Sundays and holidays.
rules.captureInstruction: Document the date, time, and nature of the noise.
rules.nextAction: Contact Planning & Building Department Code Enforcement to report the issue.

rules.title: Follow city procedures
rules.summary: Follow the local municipal code guidelines.
rules.captureInstruction: Document the date, time, and nature of the noise.
rules.nextAction: Contact local authorities.

rules.title: Follow city procedures
rules.summary: Follow the local municipal code guidelines.
rules.captureInstruction: Document the date, time, and nature of the noise.
rules.nextAction: Contact local authorities.

rules.title: Follow city procedures
rules.summary: Follow the local municipal code guidelines.
rules.captureInstruction: Document the date, time, and nature of the noise.
rules.nextAction: Contact local authorities.

rules.title: Follow city procedures
rules.summary: Animal noise is regulated by the Animal Control Ordinance. Residents are recommended to first approach the owner directly. To report a noisy animal, contact Animal Control at 510-293-7200.
rules.captureInstruction: Document the date, time, and nature of the noise.
rules.nextAction: Contact Animal Control to report the issue.

rules.title: Follow city procedures
rules.summary: Residential noise limits are 70 dBA from 7:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. and 60 dBA from 9:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. Additionally, unreasonable noise that disturbs the peace and quiet of any neighborhood is prohibited based on various criteria, regardless of decibel level.
rules.captureInstruction: Document the date, time, and nature of the noise.
rules.nextAction: Contact Police Department / Code Enforcement to report the issue.

rules.title: Follow city procedures
rules.summary: Construction and landscaping activities from 7:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. (Monday-Saturday) and 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. (Sundays and holidays) must not exceed 83 dBA at 25 feet or 86 dBA at the property plane. At all other times, standard residential limits (70 dBA day / 60 dBA night) apply.
rules.captureInstruction: Document the date, time, and nature of the noise.
rules.nextAction: Contact Code Enforcement to report the issue.

rules.title: Contact Animal Services
rules.summary: The City of Concord contracts with the Contra Costa County Animal Services Department to handle animal complaints.
rules.captureInstruction: Keep a log of when the barking occurs and how long it lasts to report to Animal Services.
rules.nextAction: Contact the Animal Services Department during normal business hours or non-business hours.
rules.officialSourceLabel: Concord Police Department Excessive Noise Resource Guide

rules.title: Report loud music to Police
rules.summary: Under Penal Code section 415(2), it is prohibited to maliciously and willfully disturb another person by loud and unreasonable noise. There are no specific time restrictions.
rules.captureInstruction: Document the date, time, and nature of the unreasonable noise.
rules.nextAction: For loud music, contact the Concord Police Department.
rules.officialSourceLabel: Concord Police Department Excessive Noise Resource Guide

rules.title: Check allowed construction times
rules.summary: Construction is generally allowed Monday through Friday from 7:30 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., and weekends from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., unless prior authorization is granted.
rules.captureInstruction: Document the address, type of construction work, and the exact times the noise is occurring outside the permitted hours.
rules.nextAction: Contact the Concord Permit Center during business hours or the Police Department during non-business hours for violations.
rules.officialSourceLabel: Concord Police Department Excessive Noise Resource Guide

rules.title: Follow city procedures
rules.summary: Keeping any animal which by frequent or long continued noise causes annoyance or discomfort to two or more reasonable persons of normal sensitiveness (or one person if it affects only one individual). Noise audible continuously for 10 minutes or intermittently for 30 minutes is prima facie evidence of a violation.
rules.captureInstruction: Document the date, time, and nature of the noise.
rules.nextAction: Contact Animal Control Officer or EHD to report the issue.

rules.title: Follow city procedures
rules.summary: Operating or playing any radio, television set, phonograph, drum, musical instrument, or loudspeaker in a manner that violates exterior or interior noise standards, unless a variance or permit has been issued.
rules.captureInstruction: Document the date, time, and nature of the noise.
rules.nextAction: Contact NCO or EHD to report the issue.

rules.title: Follow city procedures
rules.summary: Operating tools or equipment used in construction, drilling, repair, alteration, or demolition work is prohibited before 7:00 a.m. and after 7:00 p.m. on weekdays, and before 9:00 a.m. and after 8:00 p.m. on weekends and holidays.
rules.captureInstruction: Document the date, time, and nature of the noise.
rules.nextAction: Contact NCO or EHD to report the issue.

rules.title: Follow city procedures
rules.summary: It is unlawful to allow any animal or bird to howl, bark, meow, squawk, or make other annoying noises continuously and/or incessantly for an unreasonable period of time so as to create a noise disturbance across a residential real property line. Nuisance animal complaints for barking dogs require a two-week journal recording the days and times the dog was barking and a description of the dog.
rules.captureInstruction: Document the date, time, and nature of the noise.
rules.nextAction: Contact Animal Control to report the issue.

rules.title: Follow city procedures
rules.summary: It is unlawful to willfully make any loud, unnecessary, and unusual noise which disturbs the peace or quiet of any neighborhood. It is also unlawful to use any mechanical or electronic device for the intensification of any sound or noise into the public streets which causes a noise disturbance.
rules.captureInstruction: Document the date, time, and nature of the noise.
rules.nextAction: Contact Police Department to report the issue.

rules.title: Follow city procedures
rules.summary: It is unlawful to handle building materials or operate any mechanically powered saw, drill, sander, grinder, or other similar device between 9:00 p.m. and 7:00 a.m. so as to create a noise disturbance across a residential real property boundary.
rules.captureInstruction: Document the date, time, and nature of the noise.
rules.nextAction: Contact Code Enforcement to report the issue.

rules.title: Follow city procedures
rules.summary: Barking dogs that create a continuous noise disturbance for 30 minutes, or intermittent noise for 60 minutes within a 24-hour period, violate the county ordinance. Complaints are handled by the Animal Services Department.
rules.captureInstruction: Document the date, time, and nature of the noise.
rules.nextAction: Contact Animal Services to report the issue.

rules.title: Follow city procedures
rules.summary: Operating radios, stereos, or musical instruments to create a noise disturbance is prohibited. A warning is given first; if the noise persists for over 5 minutes or reoccurs within 90 days, it is a violation.
rules.captureInstruction: Document the date, time, and nature of the noise.
rules.nextAction: Contact Police Department to report the issue.

rules.title: Follow city procedures
rules.summary: Construction noise and domestic power tools are restricted. Permitted hours are generally weekdays 7:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. (power tools restricted 9:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m.) and weekends 9:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. (power tools 9:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m.), subject to decibel limits. High-impact equipment like jackhammers are banned on Sundays and holidays.
rules.captureInstruction: Document the date, time, and nature of the noise.
rules.nextAction: Contact Police Department to report the issue.

rules.title: Follow city procedures
rules.summary: Barking dogs causing a disturbance should be reported to the Public Safety desk officer.
rules.captureInstruction: Document the date, time, and nature of the noise.
rules.nextAction: Contact Public Safety to report the issue.

rules.title: Follow city procedures
rules.summary: Residential noise limits are 50 dBA during nighttime and 60 dBA during daytime. Noise before 7 a.m. or after 10 p.m. is considered a Noise Disturbance and should be reported to Public Safety.
rules.captureInstruction: Document the date, time, and nature of the noise.
rules.nextAction: Contact Public Safety to report the issue.

rules.title: Follow city procedures
rules.summary: Construction is allowed Monday through Friday from 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. and Saturday from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. No construction is permitted on Sundays or federal holidays. Owner-performed single-family residential work has extended hours.
rules.captureInstruction: Document the date, time, and nature of the noise.
rules.nextAction: Contact Public Safety to report the issue.

rules.title: Follow city procedures
rules.summary: It is prohibited to keep any animal or fowl that, by any sound, cry, or behavior, causes annoyance or discomfort to a reasonable person of normal sensitiveness in any residential neighborhood.
rules.captureInstruction: Document the date, time, and nature of the noise.
rules.nextAction: Contact Sonoma County Animal Services to report the issue.

rules.title: Follow city procedures
rules.summary: It is unlawful in any residential zone to operate radios, musical instruments, or similar devices in a manner that disturbs the peace. A noise level exceeding the ambient base level at the property line by more than 5 decibels is prima facie evidence of a violation.
rules.captureInstruction: Document the date, time, and nature of the noise.
rules.nextAction: Contact Police Department to report the issue.

rules.title: Follow city procedures
rules.summary: Specific construction noise hours are not detailed in the available text. However, operating any machinery or equipment must not cause the noise level at the property line to exceed the ambient base noise level by more than 5 decibels.
rules.captureInstruction: Document the date, time, and nature of the noise.
rules.nextAction: Contact Police Department / Code Enforcement to report the issue.

rules.title: Track barking for two weeks
rules.summary: Fremont requires a barking log tracked over two weeks with signatures from at least two other people not living at the same address.
rules.captureInstruction: Track the barking for two weeks, noting dates and times. Get signatures from two separate neighbors.
rules.nextAction: Request a Barking Log and Petition online or call 510-790-6635. Submit the completed forms within seven days after the two-week tracking period ends.
rules.officialSourceLabel: Report a Barking Dog - City of Fremont

rules.title: Observe 10 PM quiet hours
rules.summary: Fremont prohibits loud music, electronics, and noise from people between 10:00 p.m. and 7:00 a.m. Noise plainly audible from 50 feet away during these hours is a violation.
rules.captureInstruction: Note the time and duration of the noise. Try to estimate if it is audible from 50 feet away.
rules.nextAction: Contact the Fremont Police Department for active noise disturbances.

rules.title: Check construction hours
rules.summary: Construction within 500 feet of a residence is permitted on weekdays from 7:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. and Saturdays/holidays from 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Sunday construction is prohibited. Homeowners working on their own homes have extended hours until 8:00 p.m., including Sundays.
rules.captureInstruction: Note the address, type of work, start and end times, and whether it's a professional crew or homeowner.
rules.nextAction: If work is occurring outside permitted hours, contact the city to report the violation.

rules.title: Follow city procedures
rules.summary: A dog that barks, bays, cries, howls, or makes any other noise continuously for 10 minutes or longer, unless provoked or if someone is trespassing.
rules.captureInstruction: Document the date, time, and nature of the noise.
rules.nextAction: Contact Animal Care and Control (ACC) and SFPD to report the issue.

rules.title: Follow city procedures
rules.summary: Music or entertainment must not exceed ambient noise levels by 5 dBA outside residential property (or inside multi-unit properties), 8 dBA for commercial/industrial property, or 10 dBA on public property at 25 feet.
rules.captureInstruction: Document the date, time, and nature of the noise.
rules.nextAction: Contact Chief of Police or Entertainment Commission to report the issue.

rules.title: Follow city procedures
rules.summary: Construction noise is limited to 80 dBA at 100 feet. Nighttime construction (8:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m.) cannot exceed ambient noise level by 5 dBA at the nearest property plane without a special permit.
rules.captureInstruction: Document the date, time, and nature of the noise.
rules.nextAction: Contact Department of Building Inspection or Department of Public Works to report the issue.

rules.title: Contact Animal Control
rules.summary: Daly City directs animal control issues to the Peninsula Humane Society & SPCA.
rules.captureInstruction: Record the start time, end time, and duration of the barking.
rules.nextAction: Contact the Peninsula Humane Society & SPCA to report an animal nuisance.

rules.title: Quiet hours are 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM
rules.summary: Between the hours of 10:00 p.m. and 6:00 a.m., Daly City prohibits any noise, music, or sound that disturbs someone beyond the property.
rules.captureInstruction: Measure from the place where the disturbance affects you. Keep a record of the date, time, and duration.
rules.nextAction: For an active noise disturbance, call the Daly City Police Department non-emergency line.

rules.title: Quiet hours are 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM
rules.summary: Daly City prohibits noise disturbances between the hours of 10:00 p.m. and 6:00 a.m., which applies to construction noise unless otherwise permitted.
rules.captureInstruction: Document the work address, activity, start and end times, and approximate distance from your home.
rules.nextAction: If construction occurs between 10:00 p.m. and 6:00 a.m., call the Daly City Police Department non-emergency line.

rules.title: Follow city procedures
rules.summary: Animal noise nuisances, including barking dogs, are handled by the Silicon Valley Animal Control Authority (SVACA). Complaints can be submitted via their services.
rules.captureInstruction: Document the date, time, and nature of the noise.
rules.nextAction: Contact Silicon Valley Animal Control Authority (SVACA) to report the issue.

rules.title: Follow city procedures
rules.summary: Residential noise limits commence at 7:00 AM and end at 10:00 PM (55 dBA), and from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM (50 dBA). Any maliciously and willfully disturbing loud and unreasonable noise can be enforced by a citation or arrest.
rules.captureInstruction: Document the date, time, and nature of the noise.
rules.nextAction: Contact Santa Clara Police Department (SCPD) to report the issue.

rules.title: Follow city procedures
rules.summary: Construction within 300 feet of residential property is allowed Monday through Friday from 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and Saturday from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Construction is prohibited on Sundays and holidays.
rules.captureInstruction: Document the date, time, and nature of the noise.
rules.nextAction: Contact Santa Clara Police Department (SCPD) to report the issue.
